notes.title: More Players, Screens and Controllers
notes.content:
Here are some of the key recent advancements:
The split-screen player limit has now been increased to eight players. Although it is recommended to only have four players per screen.
Space Fighter can now support an incredibly large range of controllers. For the full list see first table here
Using multiple screens is now supported. Even eight screens are supported.
